name: Equinix SY5

address.value: 506-518 Gardeners Road, Alexandria NSW 2015 (marketed as Unit B, 200 Bourke Road)
address.note: DA site is 506-518 Gardeners Road; Equinix/datacentermap use Unit B, 200 Bourke Road (source 4). Building links by air bridge to SY4 at 200 Bourke Road.

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 200 Bourke Road (marketed address); DA address 506 Gardeners Rd point is -33.91948,151.18993, ~140 m away

builder.note: Stage 1 base-build head contractor not found. Erilyan delivered later works: SY5 '1P' services fit-out, Phase 2 data-hall fit-out and Phase 3 new-build extension (ECI & design & construct) (source 9).

developer.note: DA report: Developer Equinix Australia Pty Ltd; Applicant Aurecon Australasia Pty Ltd; Architect Warren and Mahoney; Owner The Trust Company Limited

mw_it.note: Stated as 'designed electrical capacity 54 MW' at full build (9,220-9,225 cabinets) - may be total electrical rather than IT load

cost_aud_m.note: Cost of works $91,489,812 for D/2017/1797 (concept + Stage 1). Equinix announced US$160m for first phase (source 5); later AU$66m expansion completed (source 7).

authority.value: City of Sydney (CEO under delegation from Central Sydney Planning Committee)
authority.note: CSPC on 21 Jun 2018 delegated determination to the CEO pending VPA exhibition

pathway.note: Concept approval for staged part 3/part 4 storey data centre, Stage 1 3-storey building. Later DA D/2021/45 for further stage (source 3).

determined.note: Deferred commencement consent granted by CEO 5 Jul 2018; activated 22 Oct 2018 after VPA execution. Modified /A (7 Aug 2018), /B (29 Oct 2018), /C-/E (2020-2021).

construction_start.note: not found (DA lodged Dec 2017; first phase due Q3 2019)

construction_end.note: First phase opened 13 Nov 2019; later phases added since (AU$66m expansion; phase 3 from 2024)

open_questions: builder (head contractor) of Stage 1 base building not found (Erilyan did later phases)
mw_it 54 is 'designed electrical capacity' - confirm IT vs total
